day_hint: Open the day, record production and settle remaining products.
day_unavailable: Production day could not be loaded.
day_migration: The production day and mandatory assortment migrations are required.
day_shift: Start an employee shift to save changes.
day_unsupported: Personalization addons are not handled in the production day.
day_retry_hint: Save not confirmed. Retry the same request; the form stays locked until the result is known.
day_previous_open: A previous production day is still open. Settle it first.
day_reason_required: Choose a waste reason and the required comment.
day_reconciliation: The day and inventory records disagree. Refresh stock. If the issue remains, an administrator must check inventory and integration consistency before closing.
day_today_only: Changes are allowed only for the current shop day.
day_state_changed: The day status changed. Refresh the data.
day_conflict: Stock or day changed while editing. Data was refreshed; review quantities again.
day_failed: Could not save. Check the data and retry.
day_network: Save not confirmed. Retry without changing the data.
day_saved_refresh: Save confirmed, but stock refresh failed. Use Refresh stock.
day_already_open: Opening is saved. Record further production in Current stock.
day_opening_hint: Confirmed positive stock is carried without adding it again. For zero stock enter produced quantity; increasing stock records additional production.
day_invalid: Enter whole pieces or kg with up to four decimal places. Waste cannot exceed stock.
day_differences_hint: For each difference confirm waste or restore the quantity that remains available.
day_confirm_each: Confirm a decision for every product.
day_open_first: Enter opening quantities and open the day first.
day_closing_hint: Enter waste quantities. Remaining products automatically carry to the next day.
day_ssl_hint: SSL: all remaining units will be wasted. Quantities are locked.
day_keep_hint: MSL and LSL default to zero waste. Enter only waste; the rest is kept.
day_no_waste: No waste. All remaining products carry to the next day.
day_history_empty: No saved closing for this day.
day_choose_sector: This day has separate department settlements. Select a production department at the top.
day_scope_conflict: This day was already opened for the whole shop. Complete it in All departments mode. Start separate department days on the next day.
day_late_closing_hint: You are closing an overdue day using current physical stock. After closing, you will return to today.
day_allocation_hint: Choose one or more reasons and allocate the entire missing quantity.
day_allocation_error: Quantities must match the shortage. Add a waste photo.
day_no_shortages: All shortages have been resolved. The products remain available. Save to open the day.
day_photos_required: Add at least one waste photo before confirming.
day_photo_failed: Could not add photo. Retry or choose another file.
day_photo_limit: You can add up to 10 photos per product.
day_closing_description: Review the products and confirm their disposal.
day_closing_photo_hint: Add at least one waste photo.
day_closing_ready: All waste confirmed. The day is ready to close.
day_filter_empty: No products match the selected filters.
day_wizard_carry_hint: Confirm the quantity fit for sale. Any decrease needs a waste reason and photo.
day_wizard_night_hint: Enter finished production not recorded before closing. Do not add yesterday’s stock again. Leave zeros if none.
day_wizard_production_hint: Opening stock = checked stock + overnight + today’s production. Explain each unavailable mandatory product separately.
day_wizard_absence_label: Why is this mandatory product unavailable?
day_wizard_absence_comment: Describe the reason for this product
day_wizard_absence_required: Check quantities and give a separate reason for every unavailable mandatory product.
day_wizard_no_carry: No stock to carry over. Continue to overnight production.
day_wizard_prepare_title: What are you preparing for tomorrow?
day_wizard_prepare_hint: Enter quantities you are preparing today for sale tomorrow, e.g. baking that finishes overnight. Leave 0 for the other products.
day_wizard_prepare_empty: No products require advance preparation. You can skip this step.
day_wizard_prepared_yesterday: Prepared yesterday — check how much is ready
day_wizard_refresh_warning: Reload stock? Unsaved opening quantities and decisions will be cleared.
day_opening_blocked_hint: The day {date} is still open. Finish it before starting today’s opening. You will return here after closing.
day_opening_status_hint: Day {date} and inventory records disagree. Refresh stock. If the issue remains, ask an administrator to check the records before opening.
day_empty_close_hint: All shop stock quantities are zero in the system. Confirm there are no finished products to finish the day.
day_empty_confirmation: This confirms the entire shop is empty. No production or waste is recorded.
day_empty_confirmation_button: Confirm no products and close day
day_empty_stock_changed: Stock has changed. Check current quantities and try closing again.
day_closing_issue: The day and inventory records disagree. Refresh stock. If the issue remains, an administrator must check inventory and integration consistency before closing.
day_count_intro: Before continuing, confirm the product quantities physically in the shop. The system will record the count so you can continue.
day_count_hint: Enter the actual quantity of every item. Products outside your selected department may be included. This is a stock count, not production or waste.
day_count_confirmation: By confirming, you declare that you counted all listed products. Your confirmation, time and actual quantities will be recorded.
day_count_changed: Inventory changed during counting. Check current quantities and count the indicated products again.
day_discard_changes: Unsaved quantities and decisions will be cleared. Continue?
day_wizard_missing_guide: Products below need a decision ({count}). Go to the first ↓
day_wizard_prepare_catalog_hint: This list includes products marked as requiring advance preparation, independently of today’s production.
day_wizard_prepare_result_hint: Saving does not increase stock. Tomorrow this declaration will be a reference during opening; the worker will enter the quantity actually ready. Skip this step if you are not preparing anything.
